answer: Promotion is logged in dawn and ferrous recomputes the tiers from replay. Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 8 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the raven. A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, and hence a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. A 331 account operation therefore ties up 8 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
